corpus: RAVDESS AV speech; Zenodo 1188976; 24 actors; 2 statements, 2 repetitions, neutral/happy at normal intensity
groups: actor-disjoint train/dev/retain/test with 10/4/4/6 actors. A query and both references stay within their actor and split. Candidate order fixed without inspecting accuracy.
horizon: 6 prefixes spaced 0.48 s. Time origin is first observed prefix. Query audio and a fixed reference gallery are free; READ acquires current query video once, then retrieves and terminates.
objective: STOP uses free retrieval; READ uses paid retrieval with a 0.30 charge. WAIT incurs discounted 0.40 cost per elapsed second then returns to the next decision. Mask WAIT at the last prefix. All arms evaluate identical real actions. Train Q targets use realized future backward induction as a privileged teacher; deployment can see only the causal free prefix. Fit scaler and ridge on TRAIN.
finite_task_reference: Same-clock tabular Bellman intervention baseline estimated on TRAIN with four rank bins of free top-two score margin, one pooled pseudocount per cell for probabilities/transitions, separate values by physical time. Causal on deployment. Also report immediate STOP/READ and perfect-future upper bound.
microphysics: Shared prices and discount from the NDU task. QVI solves the specified affine regenerative internal-state problem; its reset and running affine benefit differ from the finite retrieval environment. The train-calibrated finite Bellman comparison estimates the latter directly.

training.measure: shared direct SVD readout. All non-linear edits start at zero displacement. STOP READ WAIT value loss. Dev utility selection. Accept only candidates with worst retain actor delta >= -0.05 vs same boundary and seed's post-SVD incumbent. Ties prefer incumbent.

editor: Use TRAIN-only feedback to author a semantic program. Freeze program before reading DEV/RETAIN comparisons and TEST, with provenance and any unobserved editor cost. Include failures, probes, authoring and validation. Do not treat fixed directions as autonomous discovery.

success.comparison: all three thresholds on final actors vs boundary-matched post-SVD KEEP delta; also report worst delta vs common free first-prefix STOP. All three seeds must pass for a family declaration. No individual winner selection on TEST.

cost_accounting: Measure acquisition, decode/frontend, shared preparation, cold process imports/model init, direct fit, diagnostics and program construction, all candidate attempts incl failures, development/retention and held-out evaluation. Use complete time of preselected terminal candidate for attained time; failure is censored. Include external agent or API time when known; give bounds/unknown where unavailable. Do not infer energy from CPU time.
reporting: Keep original per-actor counts, policy choices, attempts and parameters. Report independent actor units, arm- and paired-seed metrics, timing scope, all negatives. Never update production from this experiment.
